title: Care Plan Desk Cross-Notice: Addition to an Issued Credit for a Covered Piece
content:
An addition is made to the credit issued under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes where the traded piece is covered by a plan in force under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, and its size depends on whether a claim has been settled on that cover.

## The notice

Where the piece is covered by a plan in force and no claim has been settled on that cover, four hundred (400 USD) is added. Where the piece is covered by a plan in force and a claim has been settled on that cover, one hundred and fifty (150 USD) is added. Where the piece is not covered by a plan in force, nothing is added for the cover the piece was kept under.

A plan in force is a protection plan on the piece at the active standing. Whether a claim has been settled is read from the count of settled claims that plan records.

## The three lines

| Covered by a plan in force | Claims settled on that cover | Added (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 400 |
| yes | one or more | 150 |
| no | — | nothing |

## Readings

- A covered piece with no settled claim: 400.00 USD is added.
- A covered piece with one settled claim: 150.00 USD is added; a second settled claim does not change that figure.
- A piece whose cover has lapsed and is not in force: nothing is added.
